{{Quote|You could try Taarja.''"<br />"''I don't know Taarja very well. How about you? Do any of you understand Sy Bisti? How about Taarja? Meese Caulf?|[[Maris Ferasi]] and Dubrak Qennto|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
'''Taarja''' was a [[Trade language/Legends|trade language]] used in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. When [[Gender/Legends|he]] encountered the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Chiss officer/Legends|officer]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], Taarja was one of several trade [[Language/Legends|languages]] suggested by [[Dubrak Qennto]] before Mitth'raw'nuruodo informed him that he spoke [[Sy Bisti/Legends|Sy Bisti]]. Quennto could speak Taarja, but was not very proficient in the language.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />

==Behind the scenes==
Taarja was first mentioned in the [[2006]] novel [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] by [[Timothy Zahn]].<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
